LanguageData.MAS_UnloadDesc: Remove all loaded rounds and drop them next to the launcher. Use it to empty the launcher or, after picking another ammunition type in the reload menu, to swap what is loaded.
LanguageData.MAS_Settings_RetaliationExplain: When you shell a settlement from the world map, Combat Extended may make it shell you back (50% chance per hit for industrial and spacer settlements; only one retaliation at a time). Its budget is your map's threat points (half for industrial and spacer factions, full for ultra; at least 500) x 3.5 x the faction's strength. Each shell spends its cost (81 mm mortar 250, 105 mm howitzer 1000, GMLRS 400, ATACMS 1500, Minuteman 4000, Minuteman (fission) 6000, W62 9000, W78 12000, Sarmat 20000) until the rest cannot pay for the cheapest one, with 0.5 to 4 seconds between shots. The multiplier below scales that budget for every shell type; 0% turns retaliation shelling off (counter-raids are not affected).
LanguageData.MAS_Settings_AINuclear: Factions can retaliate with nuclear missiles
LanguageData.MAS_Settings_AINuclearDesc: Spacer, ultra and archotech factions may add the Minuteman with a fission warhead (cost 6000, rare) to their retaliation; ultra and archotech ones also the W62 (9000) and W78 (12000) Minutemen and the RS-28 Sarmat MIRV (20000, rarest). A weapon is only picked while the retaliation budget can still pay for it, so the big ones only come against strong colonies. All of them leave nuclear fallout on your map.
LanguageData.MAS_Settings_AINuclearNoRimatomics: Nuclear retaliation needs Dubs Rimatomics active.
